title: EN 115-1 escalators and moving walks (through KONE's guides)
edition: EN 115-1:2017 as given in KONE's planning guides (2020 and 2008+A1 editions)
notes: EN 115-1 itself was not read; the values come from KONE's planning guides, which state them for the 2017 edition. The unrestricted area may be 2.0 m deep where it is twice as wide (not used yet).

escalator.description: Escalators at most 30°, or 35° where the rise is at most 6 m and the speed at most 0.5 m/s; speed at most 0.75 m/s; at least 2 flat steps, 3 above 6 m of rise or 0.5 m/s, 4 above 0.65 m/s; headroom 2300 mm; an unrestricted area at each landing 2500 mm deep and as wide as the handrails' outer edges + 80 mm each side; 80 mm from the handrails' outer edges to walls up to 2100 mm; moving walks at most 12° and 0.75 m/s
